limitations: Prediction accuracy and performance beyond chance are not estimable: there is no pre-event forecast or fixed source-outcome classifier.
This is a small purposively selected historical sample, not a random or exhaustive census of wars or elections. Selection and source survival can bias every summary.
The four features are existing peaceful editorial study profiles, not military, national or electoral outcome rules. No source winner/loser label is converted into a numerical target.
Every 09:00, 12:00 and 18:00 local clock and observer is an explicit study assumption. These are not certified event timestamps, actual event locations or national birth charts.
Nearby same-weekday comparisons are not verified non-event controls. Some lie during elections or prolonged wars, match other selected markers, or have unresolved overlap after unknown-ended onsets.
Control dates are reused and overlap. Logical uses are retained separately from unique cached samples. Equal weekdays and shared astronomy do not supply statistical independence.
Source event groups collapse shared country records; broader analysis groups collapse named dependent conflict phases. Independence of the remaining groups is not established.

Pooled within-observer differences are a mechanical description of selected records. Inherited profile scores across observers are not commensurable; no between-country ranking or national outcome inference is made.
All eight controls and a complete event profile are required for a paired comparison. Missing rules retain their fixed denominator and null score; partial controls are never renormalized.
Only three assumed clocks are examined. Their agreement would not prove whole-day stability; their differences expose clock dependence without identifying a best historical clock.

The optional sign-flip reference imposes unverified sign symmetry and independence. Its conditional tail fractions are not valid inferential p-values, significance evidence or predictive accuracy. Holm output was withdrawn in a pre-output amendment.
Calendar/house snapshots retain canonical selected-fixture, model, source and runtime qualifications. No religious-calendar label is an outcome predictor or added profile contribution.

primaryDescriptions.interpretation: Mechanical pooled description of selected within-observer differences only. No between-country comparability, independent-group assurance, outcome prediction or inferential claim.
